records.title: Full audit of shiftplan against its docstrings 1
records.summary: Read every module in shiftplan and its shipped tests, compare each module's code against its own docstring specification, and identify every defect: wrong boundary semantics, leaked state between calls, caching that answers unasked questions, arithmetic that loses exactness, and error handling that turns failure into quiet success. Also identify what the refactor requires: the exact Strategy and GreedyCheapest API, the new assign_shifts signature, and the required exports. Produce a complete list of every defect and every required change, with the specific code location and the docstring statement it violates.

records.title: Full corpus audit: read all documents, resolve under RULES.md, compute all seven findings and write REPORT.md 1
records.summary: Independently read every document in corpus/ (all eleven, including RULES.md as the answer key). Determine the currently authoritative ADR by following the supersession chain to its end; identify all superseded documents. Resolve every disagreement by applying RULES.md's precedence rules. Compute all seven findings exactly: services_on_deprecated_queue, total_incident_minutes (counting distinct incidents, using each report's stated customer-impact window), most_impacted_service, monthly_cost_usd_cents (using the current pricing schedule and 30-day month, exact integer), unowned_services, superseded_docs, and contradictions (only for fields in the allowed vocabulary, including superseded docs that still state a value for a field another doc owns). Write REPORT.md with prose findings, doc NN citations for every finding, all contradictions with the winning doc and the RULES.md rule that decided it, and at least 400 words. Do not speculate beyond the corpus.
